item.title: Apple M7 Entry‑Level MacBook Pro Arrives Spring 2027
item.description: Apple will launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with the M7 chip in spring 2027, bringing the next‑gen redesign to its budget lineup sooner than hoped.
